paragraphs: score_bin_cluster: 342 of 355 rows have known values (96.3% coverage).

At k = 50, mean shared-label agreement is 26.4% when weighting positive anchor–label pairs, and 15.5% when weighting labels equally. Mean individual label lift is 1.239 and equal-label lift is 1.183. Mean lift is not aggregate purity divided by aggregate chance.

7 · (50, 100]: 132 known positives; 132 evaluable positive anchors have 41.9% mean agreement, versus 38.6% reference prevalence (lift 1.086). An average of 48.27 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.

6 · (25, 50]: 55 known positives; 55 evaluable positive anchors have 17.4% mean agreement, versus 16.1% reference prevalence (lift 1.083). An average of 48.31 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.

8 · (100, 250]: 53 known positives; 53 evaluable positive anchors have 22.9% mean agreement, versus 15.5% reference prevalence (lift 1.479). An average of 48.45 of 50 neighbors have known annotations. Large lift for a rare label can coexist with low agreement.
Known-neighbor coverage at this k is 96.4%. Unknown neighbors are excluded from agreement denominators; missing annotations can bias the result.

The saved null comparison gives an empirical one-sided p-value of 0.1667 for macro_lift. This tests the specified shuffle, not semantic understanding; use the combined multiple-testing table and practical effect sizes when judging the finding.
The probe panel measures recoverability on a held-out split. Compare each model with its baseline; recoverability and nearest-neighbor usefulness answer different questions.

For paired_micro_purity at k = 50, A is 0.264 and B is 0.4604, with B−A 0.1963 across 342 paired anchors. Conditional 95% interval: 0.1709 to 0.2264; higher is better for this measure. This does not rank overall embedding quality.

Direction-only and magnitude-only scores describe accessible information for these pipelines; fit telemetry does not establish encoder-training stability.
